whenToUse: Boards that move cards between status columns by drag and drop
Roadmap and workflow views where each column is one stage of the work

whenNotToUse.when: A finished tracker for issues, tickets or releases with rich cards
A sales deal pipeline with values, owners and stage forecasts
A single flat list reordered by drag, with no columns

agentNotes: Save moves in `onValueCommit`, which fires once per drop with `previousValue` for rollback; `onValueChange` also fires mid drag
Drag listeners live on `KanbanItemHandle` and `KanbanColumnHandle`; a card or column without one cannot be dragged
`KanbanColumnHandle` is hidden until its column is hovered or the handle has keyboard focus, so keep the column title outside it
